verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੋਖਿ ਤੋਖਿ ਬਾਲਕਹਿ ਅਸਥਨ ਪਾਨ ਬਾਨਿ ਜਨਨੀ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise misaTaan paan pokh tokh baalakeh asathan paan baan jananee miTaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a mother weans away the child from sucking her breast by feeding him with sweet meats.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਸਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਉਖਦ ਖਵਾਵੈ ਬੈਦੁ ਮੀਠੋ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਤ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗਹਿ ਘਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: misaree milai jaise aaukhadh khavaavai baidh meeTho kar khaat rogee rogeh ghaTaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a physician serves medicine coated with sugar to his patient who readily swallows it, the physician thus cures the patient.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲੁ ਸੀਚਿ ਸੀਚਿ ਧਾਨਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨ ਪਾਲੈ ਪਰਪਕ ਭਏ ਕਟਿ ਘਰ ਮੈ ਲਿਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jal seech seech dhaaneh kirasaan paalai parapak bhe kaT ghar mai liaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a farmer irrigates his fields and brings up crops or rice and wheat and when ripe, harvests them and brings it home.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਾਮੁ ਸਿਖੈ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਈ ॥੩੫੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur kaamanaa pujai nihakaam kar nij padh naam dhaam sikhai pahuchaaviee ||357||

en.bdb: So does a True Guru free a Sikh from the worldly affairs and fulfils his desire of consecration. Thus he raises the Sikh high up spiritually through perpetual Naam Simran. (357)
